RealFoley2 - licences and provenance
Prepared October 17, 2026 for the Jewelry-store-vr-demo project. Status: fetched and processed; not wired; not auditioned (unverified).

Every audio file in this folder is a processed copy of one real recording. No file is synthesized, layered, NonCommercial, NoDerivatives, ShareAlike or of unknown licence.

CC0 1.0 Universal: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/  (no attribution required; credits below are voluntary)
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (show in the in-app credits and keep in Docs/ASSET_REGISTER.md):
  ElectricalHum_Loop.ogg: "electrical substation_hum.wav" by Zabuhailo (https://freesound.org/people/Zabuhailo/sounds/167673/), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); clipped by Jhrushbe (Delta-V); looped and normalised.
  EngineIdle_InspectorJ_Loop.ogg: Freesound sound 338954 by InspectorJ (www.jshaw.co.uk) of Freesound.org (https://freesound.org/people/InspectorJ/sounds/338954/), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); via Space Station 14; trimmed, looped and normalised.
  EngineStart_02.wav: Freesound sound 338954 by InspectorJ (www.jshaw.co.uk) of Freesound.org (https://freesound.org/people/InspectorJ/sounds/338954/), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); via Space Station 14; trimmed and normalised.

Licence verification: freesound.org, bigsoundbank.com and itch.io could not be opened from the preparation environment. The licence of
each recording is taken from the licence record of the GitHub mirror that supplied it (copies or excerpts in Licenses/).
ESC-50 clips: the dataset as a whole is CC BY-NC 3.0; only clips whose Freesound original is CC0 per the dataset's LICENSE are used.
Please open the original pages once before a public release. Changes to every file: trimming, mono downmix, resampling to 48 kHz,
high-pass filtering, fades, loudness normalisation, loop crossfades (see sources.json).
